method: Static inspection and SHA-pinned exact excerpts/functions executed in isolated VM with explicit mocks; not full application/browser execution

limitations: Lifecycle probe executes actual count/bounds/load-loop/child-traversal sections, not the full DOM refresh function.
Size probe uses original size functions with mocked CSS and parent fitting.
Generated STO metadata is synthesized explicitly; arbitrary original expression compilation and rich text are not covered.
Wait probe replaces scheduler with a manually released callback and eventCopy with JSON-safe copy.
